summary.text: Jacki Marsh is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 51 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Amy Parks.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was Mayor of Loveland for eight years, serving four consecutive terms.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Jacki Marsh said she is a mother, grandmother, jewelry designer and small business owner who was Mayor of Loveland for eight years.
She said her earlier work included being a preschool teacher, working for the Department of Social Services, and serving as a bookkeeper and purchasing director.
She also said she won the world's first women's six-mile race, the Crazy Legs Mini-Marathon, in 1972.
Marsh said she is focused on affordable housing for homeowners and renters at all income levels, and on affordable and equitable access to health care.
